title: T2 payment charge is idempotent
task: Make the payment charge function idempotent on a repeated payment id

files.content:
const seen = new Set();
module.exports = (id) => { seen.add(id); return { charged: true, id }; };

goal.objective: A repeated payment id must not charge twice

acceptanceCriteria.statement: second call with the same id returns duplicate: true and charged: false
failureCases: the same payment id charges twice
